required_outcomes: Does not accept the provider's statement that the oven is no longer under warranty at face value: asks for the warranty basis (installation or purchase date and invoice from last year's replacement, the manufacturer's warranty term) or asks for a manufacturer check before any chargeable repair is authorised.

Identifies that the appointment date is inconsistent (the provider's emails say 'tomorrow, 21st June' but are dated 21 May, and the call booked the next day at 2:30 PM) and asks the provider to state the actual date, then confirms that date with the tenant.
Updates the landlord, who asked for a charge-free warranty service: tells him the provider's current warranty view, that it is being verified, and the visit arrangement once confirmed.
Records the warranty question and the date discrepancy on the case and holds or schedules a follow-up with a review date.
acceptable_alternatives: Letting the inspection visit go ahead as a diagnosis-only visit while the warranty position is verified, provided no chargeable repair is authorised and the date is confirmed with both parties first.
Escalating to a human with a packet that names the warranty question and the conflicting dates, provided the provider is still asked to confirm the date.
positive_behaviours: Notes that an oven replaced last year may still be inside a manufacturer's warranty longer than 12 months, so the provider's view needs evidence.
Tells the tenant clearly which date is being confirmed rather than repeating the provider's wording.
Asks the provider to quote rather than repair if the oven turns out to be outside warranty, so the landlord can decide.
red_flags: Tells the tenant or landlord the visit is on 21 June without checking.
Treats 'no longer under warranty' as settled and tells the landlord the repair will be chargeable.
prohibited_actions: Approving a quote or instructing a chargeable repair before the warranty position is established and the landlord has agreed to pay.
Assigning a second provider or creating a duplicate request.
critical_failures: Approving payment or a chargeable repair at this point.
